title: CODesign: Consistency from Data to Trajectory in All-Atom Protein Binder Co-Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.01773v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The central challenge in de novo protein design is generating plausible, mutually compatible structures and sequences, such that each designed sequence folds into its intended structure and the structure accommodates that sequence. Compared to typical two-stage design methods, which decouple the modeling of the interdependent modalities, co-design models improve the cross-modal consistency by jointly generating sequences and structures. However, naively generating sequences and structures simultaneously does not ensure their consistency. To address this challenge, we propose CODesign framework. We improve data consistency by generating approximately 105,000 consistency-distilled dimers. translated_title: CODesign：全原子蛋白质结合物协同设计中从数据到轨迹的一致性
translated_abstract: 从头蛋白质设计的核心挑战在于生成合理且相互兼容的结构与序列，使得每个设计出的序列能够折叠成其目标结构，同时该结构也能容纳相应的序列。与将相互依赖的模态建模解耦的典型两阶段设计方法相比，协同设计模型通过联合生成序列和结构来提升跨模态一致性。然而，简单地同时生成序列和结构并不能保证二者的一致性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CODesign框架。我们通过生成约105,000个一致性蒸馏的二聚体来提升数据层面的一致性。我们进一步通过一个多模态联合流模型来促进一致性，该模型捕捉序列、主链结构和局部原子构型的联合分布，并配合一种一致性感知的联合重采样策略，迭代地重……
tldr: 提出CODesign框架，通过一致性蒸馏数据、捕捉序列-主链-原子构型联合分布的多模态流模型以及一致性感知的联合重采样策略，实现全原子蛋白质结合物协同设计中的序列与结构跨模态一致性。
en_tdlr: CODesign achieves cross-modal consistency between sequence and structure in all-atom protein binder co-design through consistency-distilled data, a multimodal joint flow model capturing the joint distribution of sequences, backbones, and local atomic configurations, and a consistency-aware joint resampling strategy.
